summary: Iteration 9 testing of 3 new features: Operator Trail, 2FA (TOTP), and Balance Ledger. 20/20 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend flows (admin, merchant) all work end-to-end: operator trail list + timeline, /security 2FA page, /ledger table (50 rows) with working Excel export (ledger_2026-10.xlsx), payout freeze+done entries. Role-based access correctly enforced (merchant/agent 403 on /api/operators; /operators route redirects non-admins). Admin 2FA left DISABLED at end as required.

balance_ledger endpoint uses str(ObjectId) comparison via account_id query — works but mixing ObjectId <-> string throughout record_ledger/queries could cause subtle bugs; add a helper and tests for admin cross-account lookups.
2FA login code field — ensure rate limiting also counts invalid TOTP codes (currently brute-force lockout keyed on password only likely; recommend verifying).
